description: 放課後の美術室で、2人の高校生と美術教師の3人が大型ポスター制作に取り組んでいる。中央では女子生徒がキャンバスに街と自然を組み合わせた絵を描き、男子生徒がパレットで色を混ぜながら次に使う色を準備している。教師は少し離れた場所から作品を見て、スケッチブックを指さしながら構図についてアドバイスしている。机の上には絵の具、筆、色鉛筆、参考写真が並び、窓際には乾燥中の小さな作品が置かれている。
imagePrompt: A high-quality, detailed illustration designed for an IELTS or Eiken English speaking picture-description test. Show exactly three people inside a bright modern Japanese high school art classroom after school: two teenage students and one art teacher. Do not include any additional people. The atmosphere should be creative, calm, positive, and collaborative. In the main foreground scene, a teenage schoolgirl wearing a school uniform with an art apron is standing in front of a large vertical canvas on an easel. She is carefully painting a colorful scene that combines a modern city, green trees, a river, and a blue sky. She is holding a paintbrush in one hand and concentrating on adding details to the painting. Beside her, a teenage boy wearing a school uniform and apron is standing at a worktable and mixing blue and green paint on a palette while comparing the colors with the large artwork. He should clearly be preparing colors for the shared project. A few steps behind them, an art teacher is holding an open sketchbook and pointing to a simple composition drawing while giving advice about where to place the main elements in the painting. The teacher should look encouraging and thoughtful. Include several visual details that create secondary descriptive opportunities without adding more people: jars of paintbrushes, watercolor paints, acrylic paint tubes, colored pencils, a cup of water, palettes, pieces of colored paper, reference photographs of buildings and nature, a desk lamp, a drying rack with several small student artworks, a classroom sink, shelves of art supplies, and large windows with warm late-afternoon sunlight. One small unfinished sketch should be clipped beside the main canvas. Make the three activities visually distinct and easy to describe: one student painting, one student mixing colors, and the teacher giving artistic guidance. Clear foreground, middle ground, and background. Exactly three visible people. No additional people, no animals, no speech bubbles, no captions, no brand logos, no copyrighted characters. Landscape 16:9 composition, clean colorful educational illustration style, highly detailed but uncluttered, expressive natural body language, suitable for an English speaking assessment.

sentences.text: The students are collaborating on a large visual project that combines urban and natural elements.
sentences.ja: 生徒たちは都市と自然の要素を組み合わせた大きな視覚作品を共同制作しています。

sentences.text: The female student appears deeply absorbed as she adds fine details to the canvas.
sentences.ja: 女子生徒はキャンバスに細かな描写を加えながら、深く集中しているようです。

sentences.text: Her partner is blending blue and green pigments in an attempt to achieve a harmonious tone.
sentences.ja: パートナーは調和の取れた色調を作るため、青と緑の顔料を混ぜています。

sentences.text: He is comparing the mixture with the existing colors before applying it to the artwork.
sentences.ja: 彼は作品に色を塗る前に、混ぜた色と現在の色を比較しています。

sentences.text: The teacher is providing constructive feedback while referring to a preliminary sketch in the notebook.
sentences.ja: 先生はノートの下絵を参照しながら、建設的な助言をしています。

sentences.text: The teacher appears to be encouraging the students to refine the balance and perspective of the composition.
sentences.grammar: appear to be＋現在分詞 / encourage＋O＋to
sentences.ja: 先生は構図のバランスや遠近感をより洗練するよう、生徒たちに促しているようです。

sentences.text: A range of artistic materials has been arranged across the worktable, suggesting that the students are experimenting with several techniques.
sentences.grammar: 現在完了受動態 / suggest that
sentences.ja: さまざまな画材が机に並べられており、生徒たちが複数の技法を試していることがうかがえます。

sentences.text: The late-afternoon light entering through the windows creates a calm and productive atmosphere in the classroom.
sentences.grammar: 現在分詞による後置修飾
sentences.ja: 窓から差し込む夕方の光が、美術室に落ち着いて創作に集中できる雰囲気を作っています。

sentences.text: The scene illustrates how artistic education can encourage creativity, cooperation, and the thoughtful exchange of ideas.
sentences.ja: この場面は、美術教育が創造性や協力、考えを丁寧に交換する力を促すことを示しています。
